Author-directed development; proposed chronology and counts · 2026-11-06
Explore the interactive shelter atlas
Locate this haven or microsystem in the atlas →
Origin and setting
Unlike instruments needed adapters before they could exchange usable results.

Human system: Lattice instrument integration service, Instrument Hearth. Programmer provenance: local human operations or application teams; no individual programmer is identified. Names here are later atlas labels, not claims that early processes named themselves.
Local process
Interface Lending supplies translation around an incompatible process instead of immediately rewriting it.
Proposed local course
The haven remains functioning and becomes a proposed receiving site for fragments whose original execution context is missing. Some adapters work; others only conceal incompatible assumptions.
Unresolved interpretations
Borrowing can enable a distinct continuity or help form a new one. The evidence need not settle which occurred.
Atlas placement

Origin step -4. 0: functioning (0 associated systems lost); 1: functioning (0 associated systems lost); 2: functioning (0 associated systems lost); 3: functioning (0 associated systems lost); 4: functioning (0 associated systems lost); 5: functioning (0 associated systems lost); 6: functioning (0 associated systems lost); 7: functioning (0 associated systems lost). These placements elaborate the current hypothetical map; they are not independently verified casualties. A functioning haven can lose continuity among particular arrivals without changing its community census status.
